description: This source file is a Java implementation of a persistence layer for searching 'things' in a MongoDB database. It provides asynchronous search functionalities, including counting, listing, and metadata streaming, specifically optimized for the 'thingsearch' service within a larger platform. The class `MongoThingsSearchPersistence` interacts with MongoDB collections, performs queries, aggregations, and handles index initialization.

classes.name: MongoThingsSearchPersistence
classes.description: Implementation of a MongoDB-based asynchronous persistence mechanism for 'thing' searches, supporting operations like count, find, and metadata streaming with index and query optimizations.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the persistence with a Mongo client and ActorSystem, configures collection and indexing.

methods.name: withHintsByNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the persistence with specific hints for namespace filtering.

methods.name: generateNamespaceCountReport
methods.description: Generates an aggregate report of number of 'things' per namespace.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous count of documents matching a query with optional authorization.

methods.name: sudoCount
methods.description: Performs an unfiltered count based solely on the query.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of Thing IDs matching a query, with sorting and authorization filtering.

methods.name: findAllUnlimited
methods.description: Retrieves all matching Thing IDs without pagination, respecting max query time.

methods.name: findAllInternal
methods.description: Internal method to create a MongoDB find publisher with applied filters, sorting, and query time constraints.

methods.name: sudoStreamMetadata
methods.description: Streams metadata of 'things', optionally starting after a lower bound ID.

methods.name: toResultList
methods.description: Converts a list of BSON documents to a paginated ResultList of Thing IDs.

methods.name: toIds
methods.description: Converts a list of BSON documents to a list of Thing IDs.

methods.name: toId
methods.description: Extracts a ThingId from a BSON document.

methods.name: getMongoFilter
methods.description: Builds a BSON filter document from a Query and optional authorization info.

methods.name: getMongoSort
methods.description: Converts Query's sort options to BSON sort.

methods.name: handleMongoExecutionTimeExceededException
methods.description: Transforms Mongo timeout exceptions into gateway-specific exceptions.

methods.name: readAsMetadata
methods.description: Reads a metadata object from a Mongo document.
